description: END18, synthetic from the rows the spec quotes for Zoom stem 20261112-170131 (2026-11-12T15:19:45.186Z = t 0): the Leave button reads invalid under a live mic and opens a hold, the mic releases 4.136 s later, the call window goes at 5.781 s, and a teardown read of the Leave button passes as healthy at 8.158 s. Before END18 that reading reverted the hold, nothing reopened it and the owner stopped by hand; now the revert is declined and the pair (window since 5.781, mic since 4.136) confirms 60 s after the later of the two. Zoom has no teardown oracle, so nothing confirms sooner. Since END21 the trim point is the mic release at 4.136, not the hold's start.
